program:
PARAMS = {
    "Wtail": (6.0, 2.0, 16.0),   # tail switch width [um]
    "Win":   (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),   # differential pair width
    "Wln":   (2.0, 0.6, 6.0),    # latch nfet width
    "Wlp":   (2.0, 0.6, 6.0),    # latch pfet width
    "Wrst":  (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # reset pfet width
    "Winv":  (1.5, 0.5, 5.0),    # output inverter nfet width (pfet = 2x)
    "Lin":   (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),  # diff pair length
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    L = 0.15
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")

    # tail switch: clk HIGH = evaluate
    n.M("MT", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wtail"], L)
    # diff pair: higher vinp discharges xp (and then on) faster
    n.M("M1", "xp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], p["Lin"])
    n.M("M2", "xn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], p["Lin"])
    # cross-coupled latch
    n.M("M3", "on", "op", "xp", "vss", "nfet", p["Wln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "op", "on", "xn", "vss", "nfet", p["Wln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "on", "op", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wlp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "op", "on", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wlp"], L)
    # reset switches: clk LOW precharges internal nodes to vdd
    for nm, nd in (("R1", "on"), ("R2", "op"), ("R3", "xp"), ("R4", "xn")):
        n.M("M" + nm, nd, "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wrst"], L)
    # output inverters: reset -> both outputs low; on falls -> outp high
    Wi = p["Winv"]
    n.M("MI1N", "outp", "on", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI1P", "outp", "on", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)
    n.M("MI2N", "outn", "op", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI2P", "outn", "op", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    op_d = lut.op("n", p["Win"], p["Lin"], 0.9 - 0.15, 0.6)
    gm1 = op_d["gm"]
    op_ln = lut.op("n", p["Wln"], L, vdd / 2, vdd / 2)
    op_lp = lut.op("p", p["Wlp"], L, vdd / 2, vdd / 2)
    gml = op_ln["gm"] + op_lp["gm"]
    cw = 1.0e-15  # ~1 fF per um of width (gate + junction, rough)
    c_node = cw * (p["Wln"] + p["Wlp"] + p["Wrst"] + 2.5 * Wi
                   + 0.5 * p["Wln"] + 0.5 * p["Wlp"]) + 2e-15
    c_x = cw * (0.6 * p["Win"] + 0.6 * p["Wln"] + 0.6 * p["Wrst"])
    itail = max(lut.op("n", p["Wtail"], L, vdd, 0.3)["Id"], 1e-5)
    # integration: output nodes fall by ~Vthp before the latch engages
    t_int = (c_node + c_x) * 0.9 / (itail / 2)
    av = max(gm1 * t_int / c_node, 1.0)
    t_reg = c_node / max(gml, 1e-6) * math.log(vdd / max(av * dv, 1e-6))
    ron_p = (vdd / 2) / max(lut.op("p", 2 * Wi, L, vdd, vdd / 2)["Id"], 1e-9)
    t_inv = 0.7 * (cl + 2e-15) * ron_p
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv

    c_sw = (2 * c_node + 2 * c_x + cl + cw * (p["Wtail"] + 4 * p["Wrst"])
            + cw * 3 * Wi)
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
